lessons.lesson: Anchor stop prices to the expected fill, not the last reference close, whenever a name has gapped or is reacting to news. Check that the stated stop distance (e.g. 10%) still holds at the likely entry price before approving.
evidence: 2026-10-20 DPZ: stop of $274.88 was set 10% under the $305.42 reference close, but the buy filled at $316.58 (about 3.7% higher), so the stop sat about 13% below entry instead of the intended 10%.
2026-10-20 MSCI rejected partly because its stop was anchored to the pre-earnings close (same flaw; not yet graded, pending).

Loop Capital Downgrades Apple to Hold, Lowers Price Target to $330: A sell-side downgrade right before a busy catalyst stretch (Oct 28 MacBook Pro event, Nov 2 earnings) with market cap above $5T. It is a counterweight to the strong iPhone Duo demand reports (82-day lead times).

UK CMA proposals on iPhone contactless access; Poland orders App Tracking Transparency changes: Regulatory pressure in Europe is piling up on services and fees. Neither is immediately material, but the direction is negative for platform economics.

Apple Commits Up To $100M With American Manufacturing Program Partner Perryman for iPhone Duo Titanium: A small dollar amount; mainly signals onshoring and tariff positioning. Combined with the Russia tariff waiver it modestly lowers tariff overhang.

Kroger Sets 7%-11% Annual EPS Growth Target Through 2029, Reaffirms 2026 Outlook: Investor-day update (8-K 7.01): FY26 guidance of $5.10-$5.30 brackets the $5.21 consensus, and the multi-year targets give clearer visibility. A stabilizing development, not a surprise.
MSCI Q3 Adj. EPS $5.11 Beats $5.02 Estimate, Sales $892M Beat: A clean beat on both EPS and revenue; the earnings risk is behind it.
Mueller Industries Q3 EPS $1.00 Misses $1.05 Estimate, Sales $1.419B Beat $1.285B Estimate: Mixed print: a big revenue beat (likely copper pricing) but an EPS miss points to margin pressure.

Evercore raises PT to $130; Deutsche Bank upgrade; Walmart+/Sam's Club bundle at $120/year: Sell-side momentum is clustering positively (BofA also reiterated Buy on ad revenue). The membership bundle supports recurring revenue. Earnings around 11-19 (estimate).
JP Morgan Maintains Underweight on Clorox, Lowers Price Target to $83: Continued bearish sell-side stance going into estimated earnings on 11-02.
UBS Maintains Buy on Tapestry, Lowers Price Target to $200: The rating holds, but the target cut trims expected upside ahead of earnings around 11-05.
Evercore ISI Group Upgrades Match Group to Outperform, Raises Price Target to $53: A rating change rather than a routine PT tweak; a positive sentiment shift ahead of earnings around 11-03.

Instacart agrees to $5M settlement with U.S. authorities over PERM recruitment discrimination: Financially immaterial; headline risk only. A separate story tags CART about a grocery-chain cyber incident, but it doesn't say Instacart is directly involved.

Loop Capital Downgrades Apple to Hold, Lowers Price Target to $330: A sell-side downgrade lands just as AAPL tops $5T. Upcoming catalysts: the Oct 28 event (touchscreen MacBook Pro, M6), strong iPhone Duo demand (82-day lead time), and earnings 10-29 or 11-02. There is also EU/UK regulatory pressure: the UK CMA wants contactless/NFC opened up, and Poland ordered changes to App Tracking Transparency. That pressure is incremental, not new.

Mueller Industries Q3 EPS $1.00 Misses $1.05 Estimate, Sales $1.419B Beat $1.285B Estimate: A big revenue beat (+10% vs consensus) with an EPS miss suggests margin compression, probably from copper pass-through. That puts quality of earnings in question rather than demand.
MSCI Q3 Adj. EPS $5.11 Beats $5.02 Estimate, Sales $892.0M Beat $885.7M Estimate: A clean, modest beat on both lines. Earnings risk is gone for now.

Kroger Sets 7%-11% Annual EPS Growth Target Through 2029, Reaffirms 2026 Outlook: FY26 adj EPS guidance of $5.10-$5.30 brackets consensus ($5.21) and comes with new long-term targets (8-K 7.01). It lowers uncertainty and adds no surprise. A separate 10-17 story says a top US grocery chain's websites are offline after a cyber incident; the chain isn't named in the input, so check whether it is KR.

Why Is Walmart Stock in the Spotlight Tuesday?: A Deutsche Bank upgrade, Evercore PT to $130 and BofA Buy/$126 (ad business), plus a $120/yr Walmart+/Sam's Club bundle. Sentiment is positive. Earnings are estimated for 11-19, so there is no near-term event risk.
JP Morgan Maintains Underweight on Clorox, Lowers Price Target to $83: A bear stays bearish, with earnings estimated 11-02.
Evercore ISI Group Upgrades Match Group to Outperform, Raises Price Target to $53: A rating upgrade, positive for sentiment. Earnings are estimated for 11-03.
UBS Maintains Buy on Tapestry, Lowers Price Target to $200: A PT trim while keeping Buy: a minor negative.
Instacart Agrees To $5M Settlement With U.S. Authorities Over Alleged Discrimination In PERM Recruitment: Immaterial in dollars; headline risk only.

Bitcoin Taps $83,000 as Iran Deal Hopes Lift XRP, ETH: BTC is recovering from a ~6% correction (support ~$80.4k). IBIT posted its biggest inflow in a year, though futures demand is weak and $333.6M in liquidations hit on 10-19. On the structural side, BlackRock filed for a downside-protected BTC ETF and JPM Coin is moving to Ethereum, both positive. Regulatory risk is a slow burn: Trump-family ties are threatening the CLARITY Act. There were no exchange failures.

Top Economist Warns US Is 'Wildly Irresponsible' With $1.99 Trillion Deficit as Interest Costs Top Defense Spending: The 10y is at 5.14% (10-19). Fed Chair Warsh's remarks have rate-hike odds in play, and with $110 Brent pushing inflation, the duration sleeve (TLT/IEF/BND) and VNQ face hike and term-premium risk. The deficit itself is background.

408x Oversubscribed AI IPO Crashes 32%; Democratic Sweep Prospects Trigger Selling in Data Center Stocks: AI/semis remain fragile. The SOX just snapped an 8-day losing streak, its longest since 2008, and midterm polling is now a sector risk for AI/data-center names. Iran's threat to undersea cables in Hormuz is a geopolitical tail risk for QQQ/VOO and oil. Mega-cap earnings ahead (META, TSLA, AMZN) add index event risk.
